name: Kolkata
air: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU)
rail: Howrah Junction (HWH)
plan: Allow two festival outings and a separate museum day. Choose your neighbourhood around the programmes you want to attend.
access: Ask pandal organisers about step-free entrances, quieter visiting hours and the distance from the permitted vehicle drop-off.

name: Mysuru
air: Mysuru Airport (MYQ)
rail: Mysuru Junction (MYS)
plan: Keep one day for the palace and another for the festival programme; add time if attending more than one major event.
access: Ask about accessible seating and the entry route for your particular Dasara event; palace access does not establish procession access.

name: Varanasi
air: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport (VNS)
rail: Varanasi Junction (BSB)
plan: Keep the festival evening free and visit Sarnath on another day. Arrange a meeting point and return transfer in advance.
access: Ask for a route without ghat steps, the closest permitted drop-off and accessible toilets. Confirm boarding assistance before arranging a boat.

name: Jaipur
air: Jaipur International Airport (JAI)
rail: Jaipur Junction (JP)
plan: Combine one festival day with two shorter sightseeing days; keep the event route separate from your sightseeing plan.
access: Ask each monument about lift or ramp access and which floors can be visited; confirm a suitable viewing area for processions.

name: Ahmedabad
air: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport (AMD)
rail: Ahmedabad Junction (ADI)
plan: Reserve time for the booked festival programme and a separate heritage visit. Confirm the actual venue rather than assuming all events use the riverfront.
access: Ask the chosen garba or kite venue about step-free entry, seating, toilets and quieter sessions; rooftop access needs a separate check.

name: Mumbai
air: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM)
rail: Mumbai Central (MMCT); choose the station shown on your train booking
plan: Choose a compact area for each day and allow a separate outing for the festival. Keep return arrangements flexible around the announced event route.
access: Ask the event organiser about crowd-managed access and drop-off points. Confirm station lifts and assistance for the exact journey you plan.

name: Kochi
air: Cochin International Airport (COK)
rail: Ernakulam Junction (ERS)
plan: Combine a confirmed Onam programme with a separate day in Fort Kochi and Mattancherry. Reserve any hosted meal directly.
access: If using a ferry, ask about boarding gradients and assistance at both jetties. Check step-free access to the selected meal or performance venue.

name: Udaipur
air: Maharana Pratap Airport (UDR)
rail: Udaipur City (UDZ)
plan: Keep the festival programme and a palace visit on separate days; leave a spare half-day for changes to local arrangements.
access: Ask which palace areas can be reached without stairs and whether a step-free festival viewing point is available. Confirm boat boarding separately.

name: Amritsar
air: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport (ATQ)
rail: Amritsar Junction (ASR)
plan: Allow time for the religious observance and a separate history-focused outing. Confirm the particular community programme before choosing dates.
access: Ask the gurdwara or event host about wheelchair routes, resting places and assistance with entry procedures; check museum access separately.

name: Hyderabad
air: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (HYD)
rail: Hyderabad Deccan / Nampally (HYB); verify your booked station
plan: Keep one outing for the festival and another for the old-city sights. Confirm where the specific Bathukamma or Bonalu programme takes place.
access: Ask about accessible viewing areas, shade, toilets and transport drop-off points for the specific procession or gathering.

name: Guwahati
air: Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport (GAU)
rail: Guwahati Railway Station (GHY)
plan: Plan around a confirmed Bihu programme and allow a separate day for city sights. This base does not cover the whole of Assam.
access: Ask the performance venue about seating and step-free entry. Confirm temple access and queue assistance directly rather than assuming it matches the concert venue.

name: Khajuraho
air: Khajuraho Airport (HJR)
rail: Khajuraho Railway Station (KURJ)
plan: Pair one or two evening performances with daytime temple visits. Check the published running order before booking your stay.
access: Ask about step-free routes, accessible toilets and reserved seating at the actual performance site; temple steps may require an alternative viewing plan.

name: Mathura and Vrindavan
air: Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) is a regional arrival option; onward travel is required
rail: Mathura Junction (MTJ)
plan: Choose the exact local Holi events first, then build transfer and rest time around them. Do not try to cover every Braj town in one day.
access: Ask the chosen temple or host about crowd controls, step-free entry, toilets and a quiet exit route. Confirm the last accessible vehicle drop-off.

name: Pushkar
air: Jaipur International Airport (JAI) is a regional gateway; onward travel is required
rail: Ajmer railway station for onward travel to Pushkar
plan: Choose the fair activities you want to see and allow time for the town and lake. Check the final programme before fixing your stay.
access: Ask about firm-surface routes at the fair, seating and accessible toilets. Confirm a route that avoids lake steps if required.

name: Puri
air: Biju Patnaik International Airport (BBI), Bhubaneswar
rail: Puri Railway Station (PURI)
plan: Keep the main festival day free and consider Konark on another day. Confirm event access and entry rules before making plans.
access: Ask organisers for accessible viewing arrangements, toilets and drop-off points. Confirm temple entry rules and do not assume attendance at a public procession includes temple admission.
sources: District transport guide — Puri rail terminus

name: Kohima and Kisama
air: Dimapur Airport; onward road travel to Kohima and Kisama
rail: Dimapur railway station; onward road travel required
plan: Allow an arrival and transfer day, one or two festival days, and time in Kohima. Confirm road transfers and visitor requirements with official tourism services.
access: Ask the festival team about gradients, firm paths, accessible toilets and seating near the programme. Confirm vehicle access to your accommodation and the venue.

name: Bengaluru
air: Kempegowda International Airport (BLR)
rail: KSR Bengaluru City railway station (SBC); check your booked station
plan: Arrange a hosted Ugadi celebration or public programme first, then choose accommodation near that neighbourhood. Leave a separate morning for the gardens.
access: Ask your host about step-free dining and seating. Check park entrance distances, resting places and accessible toilets.

name: Amalapuram and Konaseema
air: Rajahmundry Airport is a regional gateway; arrange onward road travel
rail: Rajahmundry railway station is a regional arrival option; arrange a road transfer to Amalapuram
plan: Choose an invited or publicly announced Sankranti programme and arrange local transport with your host. Keep a separate day for a Konaseema excursion.
access: Ask about vehicle access to the host village, firm paths, toilets and seating. Confirm access at each temple or archaeological site separately.

name: Thrissur
air: Cochin International Airport (COK), with onward road travel
rail: Thrissur railway station (TCR)
plan: Arrange your Vishu visit with a host or temple and leave time for the city. Treat a Guruvayur visit as a separate outing with its own entry requirements.
access: Ask about temple entry procedures, step-free routes and queue assistance. Confirm seating and dietary arrangements for any hosted meal.

name: Madurai
air: Madurai Airport (IXM)
rail: Madurai Junction (MDU)
plan: Allow a day for a confirmed Pongal programme and another for the temple and palace. Arrange village visits through a host rather than assuming celebrations are open to visitors.
access: Ask about the permitted temple entry route, queue assistance and rest stops. Check which palace areas can be reached without steps.

name: Chennai
air: Chennai International Airport (MAA)
rail: Chennai Central or Chennai Egmore; check the station on your booking
plan: Choose the Tamil New Year observance you want to attend before booking a neighbourhood. Leave a separate outing for the seafront and heritage sights.
access: Ask about accessible seating and entry at the chosen programme. Check the surface and distance of your seafront route and the nearest suitable toilet.

name: Puducherry
air: Puducherry Airport; Chennai International Airport is another gateway with onward road travel
rail: Puducherry railway station; check the current service for your origin
plan: Confirm a public Pongal programme or hosted visit, then leave another day for the museum and seafront. Book any village visit directly with a local host.
access: Ask about step-free accommodation and museum entry. Confirm pavement surfaces and road crossings on the route to your celebration.
sources: Government tourism travel and sights FAQ

name: Patna
air: Jay Prakash Narayan Airport (PAT)
rail: Patna Junction (PNBE)
plan: Confirm the designated Chhath ghat and local access arrangements. Keep the observance separate from a museum or city sightseeing day.
access: Ask the local organisers for a step-free viewing alternative, accessible toilets, lighting and the last permitted drop-off near the ghat.

name: Sonepur
air: Patna Airport, with onward road travel to Sonepur
rail: Sonepur Junction; Hajipur and Patliputra are alternative rail gateways
plan: Plan one full fair day and a shorter return visit around the confirmed programme. Compare accommodation in Sonepur and Patna with the actual transfer arrangements.
access: Ask about firm paths through the fair, accessible toilets and a seated rest area. Confirm a viewing route that avoids riverbank steps.

name: Ranchi
air: Birsa Munda Airport (IXR)
rail: Ranchi railway station
plan: Confirm a community invitation or public Sarhul or Karam programme. Leave a separate day for a waterfall excursion and arrange your return transport in advance.
access: Ask the event host about seating, toilets and step-free viewing. Ask waterfall staff about steps and alternative viewpoints before arranging an excursion.

name: Bhubaneswar
air: Biju Patnaik International Airport (BBI)
rail: Bhubaneswar railway station (BBS)
plan: Book a hosted or public Raja Parba experience and leave another day for heritage sights. Choose one excursion at a time rather than combining every stop.
access: Ask hosts about seating and toilets; confirm a ground-level alternative if swings or cave steps do not suit your access needs.

name: Jagdalpur
air: Jagdalpur Airport; Raipur Airport is a regional alternative requiring a longer road transfer. Confirm available flights before booking.
rail: Jagdalpur railway station
plan: Choose which Bastar Dussehra observances you will attend, then plan a separate waterfall day. Arrange local visits and transport with an informed host.
access: Ask about crowd-managed viewing, firm paths and seating at the festival. Check steps and accessible viewpoints at each waterfall.

name: Raipur
air: Swami Vivekananda Airport (RPR)
rail: Raipur Junction
plan: Use Raipur as a base for a confirmed Hareli programme. Arrange any village outing with the host and keep a separate half-day for the museum.
access: Ask about firm paths and seating at the rural programme, and confirm step-free access to your accommodation and museum.

name: Jhabua
air: Indore Airport, with onward road travel
rail: Meghnagar railway station, with onward road travel to Jhabua
plan: Check the specific Bhagoria market location and day before booking. Arrange a local host or guide and leave spare time between market visits.
access: Ask about market ground surfaces, shade, seating and accessible toilets. Confirm how close a suitable vehicle can reach the gathering.

name: Panaji
air: Dabolim Airport or Manohar International Airport at Mopa; check which airport your booking uses and arrange the onward transfer
rail: Karmali or other Goa rail stations, with onward road travel; choose the stop served by your train
plan: Plan around the confirmed Carnival route and keep another day for Panaji heritage. Choose accommodation with a workable return route during event road closures.
access: Ask about step-free procession viewing, seating and toilets. Confirm a drop-off outside any closed streets and check gradients on the heritage route.
sources: Goa rail and Dabolim gateway information

name: Ponda
air: Dabolim Airport or Manohar International Airport at Mopa; check which airport your booking uses and arrange the onward transfer
rail: Madgaon or Karmali are Goa rail gateways; arrange onward road travel to Ponda
plan: Check Ponda’s announced Shigmo programme and allow another day for nearby temples. Do not assume the parade takes place on the same date as other Goa towns.
access: Ask about a firm, step-free parade viewing area and accessible toilets. Confirm temple stairs, entry procedures and the distance from parking.
sources: Goa rail and Dabolim gateway information

name: Pune
air: Pune Airport (PNQ)
rail: Pune Junction
plan: Choose the Gudi Padwa or Ganesh programme first and stay within a manageable distance. Leave heritage visits for a separate day.
access: Ask organisers about step-free viewing and exits during processions. Check monument access and accessible toilets independently.

name: Daman
air: Daman Airport (NAMO Airport); check current bookable services before planning your trip
rail: Vapi railway station, with onward road travel to Daman
plan: Confirm where the public Nariyal Purnima observance takes place and leave another day for the forts. Arrange a return transfer away from the waterfront crowds.
access: Ask about firm waterfront paths, seating and toilets. Confirm whether your chosen fort route involves steps or uneven surfaces.

name: Rohtak
air: Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL), with onward travel
rail: Rohtak Junction
plan: Confirm a public Teej programme or invitation before travelling. Pair it with a separate visit to the Tilyar area.
access: Ask the event host about shaded seating, step-free entry and accessible toilets. Confirm paths and resting places for the Tilyar outing.
sources: Haryana Forest Department — Rohtak Zoo and Tilyar

name: Faridabad and Surajkund
air: Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL), with onward travel
rail: Faridabad railway station (FDB); arrange the last leg to Surajkund separately
plan: Allow a full day at the crafts mela and another shorter visit or heritage outing. Choose accommodation after checking the mela entrance and transport plan.
access: Ask the mela team about accessible gates, firm paths, seating and toilets. Check the distance between parking, entrance and performance areas.

name: Kullu
air: Kullu–Manali Airport at Bhuntar, with onward road travel
rail: Kiratpur Sahib is a rail gateway requiring onward road travel; check current connections
plan: Choose the Dussehra days that matter most to you and leave buffer time for the road journey. Keep any hill excursion on a separate day.
access: Ask about accessible festival viewing, toilets and seating at Dhalpur. Confirm the walking and climbing required for any temple excursion before committing.

name: Mandi
air: Kullu Airport at Bhuntar, with onward road travel
rail: Kiratpur Sahib or Chandigarh railway station, with onward road travel
plan: Keep the Shivratri programme day free and explore the town on another day. Allow spare time for mountain-road transfers.
access: Ask about step-free festival viewing and toilets. Check temple steps, market surfaces and the closest permitted vehicle drop-off.

name: Almora
air: Pantnagar Airport, with onward hill-road travel
rail: Kathgodam railway station, with onward road travel
plan: Arrange Harela or Phool Dei participation through a local host; household customs are not automatically visitor events. Keep sightseeing and travel days flexible.
access: Ask your host about vehicle access, gradients, steps and accessible toilets. Check the walking required for each temple and agree on an alternative if needed.

name: Chandigarh
air: Shaheed Bhagat Singh International Airport (IXC)
rail: Chandigarh railway station (CDG)
plan: Allow a day for the Rose Festival and another for a small selection of city sights. Confirm the programme before fixing your visit.
access: Ask festival staff about step-free entrances, resting places and toilets. Check narrow passages and steps before choosing a Rock Garden route.

name: Delhi
air: Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL)
rail: New Delhi, Old Delhi or Hazrat Nizamuddin; check the exact station on your booking
plan: Choose a neighbourhood and confirmed Diwali or Eid programme rather than trying to cross the whole city in one day. Leave a separate day for monuments.
access: Ask the chosen venue about step-free entrances, quiet exits and accessible toilets. Check station assistance and monument access for your exact route.

name: Srinagar
air: Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport (SXR)
rail: Srinagar railway station on the USBRL corridor; confirm your service and any interchange through Indian Railways
plan: Herath is often a household observance: arrange participation through an invitation. Leave time for the lake and gardens, and check local travel notices before departure.
access: Ask about step-free accommodation and event access. If arranging a lake outing, confirm boat boarding assistance and access at both ends.

name: Leh and Hemis
air: Leh Airport, followed by a road transfer to your base and Hemis
rail: Plan arrival by air or road; there is no local rail arrival option listed in the district guide
stay: 4–5 nights, plus any additional acclimatisation time advised
plan: Build the festival around arrival and acclimatisation time, following current official high-altitude guidance. Confirm monastery access and avoid scheduling an ambitious excursion immediately after arrival.
access: Ask about monastery steps, courtyard seating, toilets and the final vehicle drop-off. Confirm whether an alternative viewing area suits your needs.

name: Ziro
air: Donyi Polo Airport at Hollongi, with onward road travel
rail: Naharlagun railway station, with onward road travel
plan: Arrange a Dree programme visit with local hosts and leave time for the valley. Confirm current visitor requirements and road transfers before booking.
nearby: Apatani paddy-and-fish farming landscape (with a local host)
access: Ask about firm paths across the venue, seating and toilets. Confirm accommodation steps and whether farm visits can follow a suitable route.

name: Tawang
air: Guwahati Airport is a regional gateway requiring a substantial onward mountain-road journey
rail: Guwahati railway station is a regional gateway; arrange the mountain-road transfer separately
stay: 3–4 nights in Tawang, plus transfer and acclimatisation stops
plan: Arrange the journey and overnight stops before choosing festival days. Follow the district’s current high-altitude guidance and check visitor requirements, weather and road conditions.
access: Ask about monastery steps, sheltered seating and accessible toilets. Confirm vehicle access to accommodation and whether your route can avoid long outdoor waits.

name: Jorhat
air: Jorhat Airport at Rowriah
rail: Jorhat Town or Mariani Junction; choose the station served by your train
plan: Arrange a hosted Magh Bihu experience and leave another day for nearby heritage. Confirm invitations and meal arrangements directly rather than expecting entry to a private gathering.
access: Ask your host about firm paths, seating and accessible toilets. Confirm access procedures and footwear arrangements at the prayer hall.

name: Imphal
air: Bir Tikendrajit International Airport (IMF)
rail: Direct passenger rail arrival in Imphal has not been verified. The Jiribam–Imphal project remains a separate connection to check with Indian Railways; do not book on the assumption that Imphal station is operating.
plan: Confirm the current Yaoshang or Sangai programme and local travel arrangements before booking. Keep city visits and a Loktak excursion on separate days.
access: Ask the organiser about step-free venue entry, seating and toilets. If arranging a lake visit, confirm boarding assistance and a land-based alternative.
sources: Railway project status — Ministry of Railways

name: Tura
air: Guwahati Airport, with onward road travel
rail: Guwahati railway station is a regional gateway, with onward road travel
plan: Confirm the specific Wangala venue and arrange transfers from Tura. Keep an extra day for an optional nature outing with locally confirmed access.
access: Ask about firm paths, seating and toilets at the Wangala ground. Check trail gradients and whether an alternative viewpoint is possible before a nature excursion.
sources: Meghalaya Tourism — Tura and nearby sights

name: Smit and Shillong
air: Shillong Airport is an arrival option; arrange onward road travel to Smit
rail: Guwahati railway station is a regional gateway; onward road travel via Shillong is required
plan: Use Shillong or a locally arranged stay as your base and confirm transport to the Nongkrem programme in Smit. Keep a separate outing for the Laitlum area.
nearby: Smit’s traditional royal residence area (access by local permission)
access: Ask about firm paths and seating around the dance ground, toilets and the last vehicle drop-off. Check viewpoint edges, steps and gradients before visiting.

name: Aizawl
air: Lengpui Airport (AJL), with onward road travel
rail: Sairang railway station, with onward road travel to Aizawl; check current train availability
plan: Choose a confirmed Chapchar Kut or Mim Kut programme and leave another day for city heritage. Confirm current visitor requirements and transport from your arrival point.
access: Ask about step-free routes, lifts and vehicle access at your accommodation. Confirm seating and accessible toilets at the actual festival venue.
sources: Sairang rail connection — Ministry of Railways review

name: Mokokchung
air: Jorhat Airport, with onward road travel
rail: Mariani Junction in Assam, with onward road travel
plan: Arrange Moatsu participation through the host village and allow time for the approach journey. Confirm current visitor requirements and permissions before village visits.
access: Ask hosts about village paths, steps, seating and toilets. Confirm where your vehicle can stop and whether the planned walking route suits you.

name: Gangtok
air: Bagdogra Airport is a regional gateway; arrange the onward mountain-road journey
rail: New Jalpaiguri railway station, with onward road travel
plan: Confirm the Losoong or Namsoong programme and its actual venue. Allow an arrival buffer and keep monastery and museum visits on a separate day.
access: Ask about road access, gradients and steps at your accommodation and monastery. Confirm seated viewing and accessible toilets at the festival venue.

name: Agartala and Old Agartala
air: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport (IXA)
rail: Agartala railway station (AGTL); arrange onward travel to Old Agartala if needed
plan: Confirm the Kharchi or Garia programme and host location. Set aside a separate outing for Ujjayanta Palace and arrange your return from Old Agartala in advance.
access: Ask about accessible temple queues, shaded seating and toilets. Confirm step-free museum entry and the permitted vehicle drop-off at the festival.

name: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)
air: Veer Savarkar International Airport
rail: Rail does not reach the islands; plan arrival by air or an independently confirmed sea passage
plan: Confirm the Island Tourism Festival venue and programme, then leave another day for museums. Add separate time and confirmed transport for any inter-island extension.
access: Ask the festival team about firm paths, seating and accessible toilets. Confirm museum access and boarding assistance separately if adding a boat journey.
